description: §66.3 rule 5 (g): `seven()` declares no return type and returns a local, which never counts toward an inferred-and-proven return — so `<v=(seven())/>` is E-DECL-TYPE-NOT-INFERABLE.
rationale: §66.3 rule 5: "A function's return is inferred-and-proven when … every `return` carries an expression that is a member of this set … reading the function's PARAMETERS as typed `@ref`s … and never a local binding"; rule 7: a call whose return is neither declared nor proven is outside the set. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package" (dd own-value-type-annotation-o35d-dpa-065 §7 item 1: "calls to functions with a declared or inferred-and-proven return").
